title: USDA AD-1049
description: Drug-free-workplace certification for grantees other than individuals. Workplace and project answers are separate from cover-owned organization/representative and submission-owned signature/date.
notes: Pinned original FID695/version2.0 PDF, XLS and three-file XSD closure are the source baseline; current official successor edition is not asserted. OMB expiration September30,2025 and revision12/22 are preserved.
Workplaces are optional0..10. The on-file checkbox is independent and uses exact Y: Yes/N: No strings; no absent-to-No default or new certification answer is added.

A local WorkplaceAddress composes the existing eight AddressParts/enums. Unlike generic Address hiding Province for USA, this use disables inactive State/Province and declares no clearing. Source form XML permits both sequential optional elements; retained inactive values require actual consumer proof.

Organization and representative name/title are cover-owned; signature/date are completed by Grants.gov upon submission. Full-contract samples contain explicitly illustrative producer context. An applicant-only draft is intentionally incomplete against transmitted required context.
Full certification commitments, privacy/burden/civil-rights notices and page-three instructions are retained as nonanswer layout descriptions attached to nonempty review sections.

The XSD target is source-shaped and has no active Mapping.from. XML lowering, authentic context production, signing/submission and production registration are integration obligations, not definition acceptance.

risks: Current library native address entry requires actual country-condition/retention and list-cardinality proof; visual activity must not silently decide answer deletion.
DAT MM-DD-YYYY date display differs from the ISO JSON date displayed by current Text support; the difference remains explicit.
DAT clickable USDA complaint-page/mailto destinations are preserved exactly as literal text; clickable behavior remains a shared presentation integration gap.
Readonly presentation is not authenticated immutable context or an authentic signature. No agent check establishes legal attestation or human acceptance.
